title: Design System: Dungeons and Dragons Campaign Companion

display.purpose: Cinzel battle name in the rail head and field-manual heading.

headline.purpose: Cinzel titles for drawer dialogs and invite headings.

title.purpose: 800-weight sans for team, army, goal and result names.

body.purpose: Descriptions, notes and form text at 0.78 to 0.88rem.

label.purpose: Tags, counts, counter bands and fact captions; sentence case.

shadows.name: stage-vignette

shadows.name: board
shadows.purpose: Map board floating on the stage.

shadows.name: dialog-centred
shadows.purpose: Centred map picker and final scores.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single flat accent action per phase.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.15rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156)); background: rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156)); color: #14110a; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary action on dark translucent fill with an accent hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.15rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.36); background: rgba(14,13,10,0.82); color: #e8e8e8; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s, border-color 0.18s, color 0.18s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.09); border-color: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.6); color: #fff; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill choice with pressed state, used instead of dropdowns.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.1rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.36); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #e8e8e8; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.65); color: #fff; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.2); border-color: rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156)); color: #d4c19c; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark inset field with an accent hairline.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.36); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 0.88rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7f7a6e; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.7); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Army Counter
components.description: Square wargame counter: faction band, unit glyph, troop count, movement bar.
components.html: 1st Legion420
components.css: .ds-counter { width: 3.7rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1.5px solid #3b82f6; border-radius: 6px; background: #15130e; box-shadow: 0 7px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1); text-align: center; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-counter:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-counter-band { display: block; padding: 0.18rem 0.3rem; background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1.1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-counter-body { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 0.12rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.2rem 0.3rem; color: #f1ede2; } .ds-counter-body svg { color: #3b82f6; filter: brightness(1.35); } .ds-counter-body b { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; } .ds-counter-move { display: block; height: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); } .ds-counter-move i { display: block; width: 70%; height: 100%; background: rgb(124,205,143); }

components.name: Round Track and Phase Steps
components.description: Round segments plus three phase steps; the current one takes the phase tone.
components.html:
Round 2 of 5
PlanningOrdersResolution
components.css: .ds-round { --phase-rgb: var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; color: #e8e8e8; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-round-label span { color: #a29d90; font-weight: 500; } .ds-round-track { flex: 1; display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; gap: 3px; } .ds-round-track i { height: 6px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-round-track i[data-state='done'] { background: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.55); } .ds-round-track i[data-state='now'] { background: rgb(var(--phase-rgb)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(var(--phase-rgb), 0.4); } .ds-phases { --phase-rgb: var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 0.25rem; margin-top: 0.6rem; } .ds-phases span { position: relative; text-align: center; padding: 0.2rem 0.2rem 0.45rem; color: #a29d90; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-phases span::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); } .ds-phases span[data-state='done'] { color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-phases span[data-state='done']::after { background: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.55); } .ds-phases span[data-state='now'] { color: rgb(var(--phase-rgb)); font-weight: 800; } .ds-phases span[data-state='now']::after { background: rgb(var(--phase-rgb)); }

components.name: Goal Row
components.description: Pressed-state list button used for goals, targets, people and armies.
components.css: .ds-goal { display: grid; gap: 0.2rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.16); border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-goal:hover { border-color: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.36); background: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.09); } .ds-goal[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156)); background: rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.13); } .ds-goal-name { color: #fff; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-goal-desc { color: #a29d90; font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-goal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Small outlined status label with good, bad, warn and info tones.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(var(--theme-accent-rgb, 212, 193, 156), 0.36); color: #e8e8e8; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tag[data-tone='good'] { color: rgb(124,205,143); border-color: rgba(124,205,143,0.45); } .ds-tag[data-tone='bad'] { color: rgb(238,116,106); border-color: rgba(238,116,106,0.45); }

narrative.overview: The app is a dark, warm-charcoal companion used in dim rooms, with one seasonal accent threaded through every border, focus ring and active state. The Battlefield tab is the clearest expression of it: the map is the table, and everything else (round track, phases, orders, dialogs) is a staff instrument at its edge. Colour is restrained; the accent means "active", steel means "planning", crimson means "resolution", and green/red are reserved for good/bad state. Numerals are tabular everywhere so troop counts and distances do not jitter.
keyCharacteristics: One seasonal accent via --theme-accent-rgb; never hard-code the accent hex.
1px accent-tinted hairlines (16% rest, 36% strong) instead of filled borders.
Cinzel only for battle name, phase/dialog titles, and manual headings.
Armies are square wargame counters (faction band, lucide unit glyph, troop count, movement bar).
Cartographic details are drawn from real data: scale bar in feet, dashed movement ring, solid range ring.
Drawer dialogs keep the map visible; only catalogues and interruptions are centred.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The accent is the single decorative colour. Phase tones, good/bad and faction colours are information, never ornament.

rules.name: The Variable Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colour is always rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb)) or an alpha of it, so the season can re-tint the surface.

rules.name: The No Gradient Buttons Rule
rules.body: Buttons are flat fills. The theme's gold gradients exist for the wider app and do not appear on Battlefield controls.

rules.name: The Cinzel Ration Rule
rules.body: Cinzel appears only on names and titles (battle, dialog, manual, invite headings, empty-board caption). Never on buttons, tabs, table cells or figures.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes (troops, feet, scores, rounds) sits in a tabular-numeral context.

rules.name: The Seated Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black, blurred and vertical; they say "this sits on the table". Colour glows are not used for depth.

dos: Do colour with rgb(var(--theme-accent-rgb)) and alphas of it; keep hairlines at 0.16 (rest) and 0.36 (strong).
Do keep one flat primary button per phase, with ink-on-accent text (#14110a).
Do use lucide icons at 11 to 19px, always paired with text or an accessible label.
Do use Cinzel for names and titles only, and the system sans for everything operational.
Do put task dialogs in the right drawer so the map stays visible; centre only catalogues and interruptions.
Do use steppers and pressed-state chips or list buttons for numeric and choice input.
Do show the state that decides a move (movement left, range, lock status) and respect the fog layer above the map.
donts: Don't use emoji discs or circles for armies or factions; counters and swatches are square.
Don't use gradients on buttons or hard-offset shadows; shadows are soft, black and vertical.
Don't add new hues for status; use steel, crimson, green and coral as established.
Don't use bare number inputs or dropdowns where a stepper or chip row fits.
Don't hard-code the accent hex or the season; read it from the variable.
